# Summary

Reviewers asked that Supplementary Table 2 report seroprevalence at age 6 months, by birth type
and by community type, not only for trachoma (Pgp3) but also for onchocerciasis (Ov16) and yaws
(rp17 and TmpA; a child is yaws-positive only if positive to *both* antigens, matching the
composite definition used elsewhere in the manuscript, e.g. `3-ecomid_elimination_prev_ests_4.Qmd`).


# Preamble

```{r preamble}
library(here)
here()
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
source(here("R","0-config.R"))

```

# Load datasets

## Luminex data

```{r load antibody data}
#-------------------------------
# load the formatted MBA data
# for EcoMID, created by
# 0-all_sero_results_dataclean.Rmd
#
# data are in long format
#-------------------------------
d <- read_rds(here("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EcoMID/data/serology/final/ecomid_serology_datasets","ecomid_sero_antigen_seropos_long_v02_20261007.rds"))

# drop monitoring targets
d1 <- d %>%
  filter( !antigen %in% c("gst","monitor","vero"))
```

## Survey and household data

```{r load child visit data}
#-------------------------------
# load child visit data for
# exact dates at age of DBS collection
#-------------------------------
dvisit <- read_rds(file=here("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EcoMID/data/ecomid-field/final","ecomid_child_visit_info_2026-06-15.rds"))

#-------------------------------
# load household characteristics
# to use type of delivery
#-------------------------------
dhh <- read_csv(file = here("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/EcoMID/data/ecomid-field/final","surveydata_20251003.csv")) %>%
  mutate(childid = paste0(community,"B",str_pad(house_ID,4,pad="0"))) %>%
  select(childid,vagbirth)

#-------------------------------
# join visit ages to serology
# data and create a final age
# variable
# also join delivery type
#-------------------------------
d2 <- d1 %>%
  left_join(dhh, join_by("childid")) %>%
  left_join(dvisit, join_by("community","community_name","childid","timepoint"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(age_days = case_when(
    !is.na(agedays_dbs) ~ agedays_dbs,
    is.na(agedays_dbs) & !is.na(agedays_stool) ~ agedays_stool,
    is.na(agedays_dbs) & is.na(agedays_stool) ~ agedays_svy,
    TRUE ~ NA
  ),
    # there are 2 children with visits that don't appear in the childvisit data
    # for them, it is both at 12 months, so assume age is DOB + 365 days
    agedays = ifelse(is.na(age_days), difftime(time1=dob, time2=dob + 365, units="days"), age_days),
  age_months = age_days/30.4,
  age_years = age_days/365.25 )
```

# Seroprevalence at 6m, all three elimination targets

```{r process multi-pathogen 6m data}
#-------------------------------
# filter to the four antigens used
# to define the three elimination-
# target pathogens (trachoma, oncho,
# yaws), and pivot wide so we can
# define the yaws composite
# (rp17 AND tmpa both positive)
#-------------------------------
d_multi <- d2 %>%
  filter(antigen %in% c("pgp3","ov16","rp17","tmpa")) %>%
  select(community_type, vagbirth, childid, timepoint, sampleid, antigen, seropos) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(community_type, vagbirth, childid, timepoint, sampleid),
              names_from = antigen, values_from = seropos) %>%
  mutate(
    trachoma = pgp3,
    oncho = ov16,
    yaws = ifelse(rp17 == 1 & tmpa == 1, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(community_type, vagbirth, childid, timepoint, sampleid, trachoma, oncho, yaws) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(trachoma, oncho, yaws), names_to = "pathogen", values_to = "seropos")

#-------------------------------
# simplified community type, same
# convention as the Pgp3-only
# analysis in file 5
#-------------------------------
d4_multi <- d_multi %>%
  mutate(community_code = substr(sampleid,1,1),
         community_type = case_when(
           community_code == "E" ~ "Esmeraldas",
           community_code == "B" ~ "Borbon",
           TRUE ~ "Rural villages"),
         community_type = factor(community_type, levels=c("Esmeraldas","Borbon","Rural villages"))
  )

#---------------------------------
# identify, per child per pathogen,
# whether they were seropositive
# at the age-6-month visit
#---------------------------------
dcum_multi <- d4_multi %>%
  group_by(childid, pathogen) %>%
  mutate(pos6m = ifelse(timepoint == 6 & seropos == 1, 1, 0),
         pos6m = max(pos6m, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(community_type, vagbirth, childid, pathogen, pos6m) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r estimate multi-pathogen 6m seroprevalence}
#---------------------------------
# estimate % positive at 6 months
# for each pathogen: overall, by
# birth delivery type, and by
# community type
#---------------------------------
est_pos6m_overall_multi <- dcum_multi %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  summarize(nchild = sum(!is.na(pos6m)),
            npos = sum(pos6m, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(prev6m = npos/nchild*100,
         prev6m_min95 = binom.test(x=npos,n=nchild)$conf.int[1]*100,
         prev6m_max95 = binom.test(x=npos,n=nchild)$conf.int[2]*100
        ) %>%
  mutate(table_label = "Overall")

est_pos6m_comm_multi <- dcum_multi %>%
  group_by(pathogen, community_type) %>%
  summarize(nchild = sum(!is.na(pos6m)),
            npos = sum(pos6m, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(prev6m = npos/nchild*100,
         prev6m_min95 = binom.test(x=npos,n=nchild)$conf.int[1]*100,
         prev6m_max95 = binom.test(x=npos,n=nchild)$conf.int[2]*100
        ) %>%
  rename(table_label = community_type)

est_pos6m_birth_multi <- dcum_multi %>%
  group_by(pathogen, vagbirth) %>%
  summarize(nchild = sum(!is.na(pos6m)),
            npos = sum(pos6m, na.rm=TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(prev6m = npos/nchild*100,
         prev6m_min95 = binom.test(x=npos,n=nchild)$conf.int[1]*100,
         prev6m_max95 = binom.test(x=npos,n=nchild)$conf.int[2]*100
        ) %>%
  mutate(table_label = ifelse(vagbirth == 1, "Vaginal birth","Cesarean section"))

est_pos6m_multi <- bind_rows(est_pos6m_overall_multi, est_pos6m_birth_multi, est_pos6m_comm_multi) %>%
  select(-vagbirth) %>%
  mutate(
    pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = c("trachoma","oncho","yaws"),
                       labels = c("Trachoma, C. trachomatis (Pgp3)",
                                  "Onchocerciasis, O. volvulus (Ov16)",
                                  "Yaws, T. pallidum (rp17, TmpA)")),
    table_label = factor(table_label, levels = c("Overall","Vaginal birth","Cesarean section",
                                                  "Esmeraldas","Borbon","Rural villages")),
    prev6m_print = paste0(sprintf("%1.1f",prev6m)," (",sprintf("%1.1f",prev6m_min95)," to ",sprintf("%1.1f",prev6m_max95),")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(pathogen, table_label) %>%
  select(pathogen, table_label, everything())

kbl(est_pos6m_multi %>% select(pathogen, table_label, nchild, npos, prev6m_print), digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Pathogen","Population","N children","N positive","Seroprevalence at 6m (95% CI)"),
    caption = "Seroprevalence at age 6 months to Pgp3 (trachoma), Ov16 (onchocerciasis), and rp17/TmpA (yaws), overall, by type of birth delivery, and by community type -- long format") %>%
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")

write_csv(est_pos6m_multi, file = here("output","ecomid_si_table2_seroprev_6m_by_pathogen.csv"))
```

## Reshape to wide format for Supplementary Table 2

This assumes the "N children" denominator is (for practical purposes) identical across the three
pathogens within each stratum. That's not guaranteed -- yaws requires *both* rp17 and TmpA
non-missing, while trachoma/oncho each require only one antigen non-missing, and the main Table 2
already shows slightly different N Tested by pathogen overall (1,601 vs. 1,605). So before
collapsing to a single column, check for any mismatch and surface it rather than silently picking
one pathogen's denominator.

```{r check nchild consistency across pathogens}
#-------------------------------
# pivot N children wide by pathogen
# to check whether the denominator
# is really the same across all three
# pathogens for every stratum
#-------------------------------
nchild_check <- est_pos6m_multi %>%
  select(table_label, pathogen, nchild) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = table_label, names_from = pathogen, values_from = nchild)

nchild_check

nchild_mismatch <- nchild_check %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(mismatch = length(unique(c_across(-table_label))) > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(mismatch)

if (nrow(nchild_mismatch) > 0) {
  warning("N children differs across pathogens for at least one stratum -- see nchild_mismatch. ",
          "The wide table below will still show a single N children column (from trachoma) -- ",
          "double check whether that's appropriate before using it in the SI.")
  print(nchild_mismatch)
} else {
  message("N children matches across all three pathogens for every stratum -- safe to show a single N children column.")
}
```

```{r reshape wide for supplementary table 2}
#-------------------------------
# short pathogen key for pivoting
# column names cleanly, then pivot
# N positive and seroprevalence
# wide by pathogen; keep a single
# N children column (from trachoma,
# per the consistency check above)
#-------------------------------
tbl_si2_wide <- est_pos6m_multi %>%
  mutate(pathogen_key = case_when(
    grepl("^Trachoma", pathogen) ~ "trachoma",
    grepl("^Onchocerciasis", pathogen) ~ "oncho",
    grepl("^Yaws", pathogen) ~ "yaws"
  )) %>%
  select(table_label, pathogen_key, nchild, npos, prev6m_print) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = table_label,
    names_from = pathogen_key,
    values_from = c(nchild, npos, prev6m_print)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    table_label,
    nchild = nchild_trachoma,
    npos_trachoma, prev6m_print_trachoma,
    npos_oncho, prev6m_print_oncho,
    npos_yaws, prev6m_print_yaws
  ) %>%
  arrange(table_label)

kbl(tbl_si2_wide, digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Population","N children",
                  "N positive","Seroprevalence (95% CI)",
                  "N positive","Seroprevalence (95% CI)",
                  "N positive","Seroprevalence (95% CI)"),
    caption = "Revised Supplementary Table 2. Seroprevalence at age 6 months to Pgp3 (trachoma), Ov16 (onchocerciasis), and rp17/TmpA (yaws), overall, by type of birth delivery, and by community type") %>%
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Trachoma, C. trachomatis (Pgp3)" = 2,
                                  "Onchocerciasis, O. volvulus (Ov16)" = 2,
                                  "Yaws, T. pallidum (rp17, TmpA)" = 2)) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(group_label = "Overall", start_row = 1, end_row = 1) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(group_label = "Birth type", start_row = 2, end_row = 3) %>%
  kableExtra::group_rows(group_label = "Community type", start_row = 4, end_row = 6) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")

write_csv(tbl_si2_wide, file = here("output","ecomid_si_table2_seroprev_6m_by_pathogen_wide.csv"))
```
